name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three static HTTPS virtual hosts, including document roots, sample content, TLS, security settings, firewall, fail2ban, and SSH/sysctl hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and cleanup of generated replication-related configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment and dependencies, initializes its database, writes environment configuration, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
